description: Create one empty COMP under parent_path to hold a visual system, then tile it into the parent's network grid clear of existing siblings. `comp_type` picks a Container COMP (a 2D panel) or a generic Base COMP. Returns the created node's path, type, and name. Use a higher-level Layer 1 tool instead when you want a fully built, wired network rather than an empty shell.

name.description: Name for the new COMP; TouchDesigner auto-generates one when omitted.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the container in.
